statement: You receive one line. Read an integer from its start the way atoi does: skip leading spaces, accept one optional + or -, then consume digits while they last. Everything after the digits is ignored. Clamp the result into the 32-bit range, -2147483648 to 2147483647, and print it. When no digit is found at the expected place, print 0.

example.why: Spaces are skipped, the sign is taken, 42 is read, and the text after it is ignored.

hint: Test the clamp before multiplying by ten; in fixed-width arithmetic afterwards is too late.
mistake: Accepting a sign after a digit or a second sign - the scan must stop there instead.
